post.caption:
A century of research and there is still no agreed answer. Four theories compete: dreams as memory consolidation and sorting, as threat simulation and rehearsal, as emotional processing that takes the sting out of a memory while keeping it, and the activation-synthesis view that random signals fire and the brain builds a story around them. All four have real supporting evidence, which is exactly why none has won. You will spend roughly six years of your life doing it.

One science idea a day. Follow so you don't miss tomorrow's.
